papers.title: The cyclic deformation behavior and microstructural evolution of 304L steel manufactured by selective laser melting under various temperatures
papers.first_author_affiliation: Failure Mechanics and Engineering Disaster Prevention Key Laboratory of Sichuan Province, College of Architecture and Environment, Sichuan University, Chengdu, 610065, China

corresponding_authors.name: Hong Zhang
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Failure Mechanics and Engineering Disaster Prevention Key Laboratory of Sichuan Province, College of Architecture and Environment, Sichuan University, Chengdu, 610065, China

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究SLM制备的304L钢在不同温度下的循环变形行为，未涉及生物医学植入物材料、多孔结构或应力屏蔽。
llm.why_not_core: This paper studies cyclic deformation of 304L steel for structural applications, not biomedical implant materials (e.g., Ti alloys), with no porous structures, stress shielding analysis, fatigue for biomedical context, or osseointegration.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究SLM 304L钢在不同温度下的循环变形行为。
summary_zh.method: 通过应变控制疲劳实验和微观表征分析。
summary_zh.result: 发现温度影响循环硬化和微观组织演变。
summary_zh.validation: 实验力学测试与微观结构观察。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the cyclic deformation behavior and microstructural evolution of 304L steel fabricated by selective laser melting under various temperatures.
summary_en.method: Strain-controlled fatigue tests combined with microstructural characterization (EBSD, TEM) were conducted.
summary_en.result: Temperature significantly influences cyclic hardening/softening behavior and dislocation substructure evolution.
summary_en.validation: Experimental mechanical testing (fatigue) and microstructural analysis validated the findings.

papers.title: Day-case hip and knee arthroplasty: stages of care and the development of an institutional pathway
papers.abstract: Day-case, or outpatient, arthroplasty is growing and has been adopted in healthcare systems because of its cost-effectiveness. A number of studies that reported on day-case total hip arthroplasty, total knee arthroplasty and unicompartmental knee arthroplasty have shown that they can be performed successfully in a select group of patients. However, safety remains a concern, as a clear pathway, including discharge criteria, is not well described in the literature. This article outlines the stages of care involved in day-case hip and knee arthroplasty and gives insights from University College London Hospital's own evidence-based day-case arthroplasty pathway.
papers.first_author_affiliation: Department of Trauma and Orthopaedic Surgery, University College London Hospital, London, UK

corresponding_authors.name: Warran Wignadasan
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Trauma and Orthopaedic Surgery, University College London Hospital, London, UK

llm.relevance_to_user: 这篇论文讨论的是临床日间髋膝关节置换路径，完全没有涉及生物力学分析、应力遮挡或微动等用户关注的核心问题。
llm.why_not_core: The paper describes a clinical pathway for day-case arthroplasty without any finite element analysis, stress/shielding quantification, micromotion modeling, or implant design evaluation—core elements needed for the user's hip implant biomechanics research.

summary_zh.motivation: 探讨日间髋膝关节置换术的临床路径及安全性
summary_zh.method: 回顾性分析伦敦大学学院医院的日间关节置换路径实践经验
summary_zh.result: 提出标准化的日间关节置换流程和出院标准
summary_zh.validation: 无实验验证，仅为临床路径描述

summary_en.motivation: This paper describes the development of an evidence-based day-case arthroplasty pathway for hip and knee replacements, focusing on safety and cost-effectiveness.
summary_en.method: The authors outline the stages of care and discharge criteria based on UCLH's institutional experience.
summary_en.result: A standardized day-case arthroplasty pathway is presented to guide patient selection and postoperative management.
summary_en.validation: No experimental validation; the paper is a clinical pathway description without quantitative biomechanical assessment.
